name: Run
description: A forward run: a longer stride than the walk, a deeper forward lean, arms bent and driving, and both feet off the ground at the flight poses.
poses: contact: left foot lands forward, right arm driving back, body leaning in
down: weight settles onto the left leg, body at its lowest
push: left leg drives back, body rising, right knee coming forward
flight: both feet off the ground, right leg reaching forward
contact: right foot lands forward, left arm driving back
down: weight settles onto the right leg before the next push
